note: FIRST DRAFT, NOT PIPELINE OUTPUT. Written directly rather than produced by `npm run i18n:translate`, because no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY was configured when Czech was turned on. The key structure is generated from the English files, so it matches exactly, and the wording follows content/glossary.json. When the pipeline is first run for cs, the diff against this draft is the acceptance test for the pipeline.
